steps.title: More supply
steps.say: The blue line is supply. Shifting it right means sellers bring more goods to the market at every price.

ops.text: Why more supply lowers the price

steps.title: Surplus and lower price
steps.say: With more goods competing for the same buyers, sellers cut prices to clear their stock, so the equilibrium slides down along the demand curve.

steps.title: Try shifting demand
steps.say: Now try dragging the red demand curve to see how buyers moving their demand changes the price.
